blurb: The 18-hole championship golf course offers a layout designed by David L Moote with rolling fairways, classic greens and bunkers, and a unique 19th island green hole. The course is easy to walk and promotes a reasonable pace of play. Facilities include a full practice and training area and a full service clubhouse for events.
